title: qa(checklist): the coverage sweep gains an angle — surface kinds vs the one design system, screenshot-oracle items per kind (SWEEP.md row + the skill's angle count; maintainer-directed)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task**. Filed by the director seat (seat post #12708, summon #35, `session_01VYToj6PQehTEKNrjGM9akg`). The maintainer asked whether the North Star should carry UI-quality requirements after finding an ugly console dialog (「北极星是否应该加上用户体验,用户界面美观度相关的要求,我发现了很丑的界面」); the seat proposed one North Star sentence plus one coverage-sweep angle that gives it a measurable form; the maintainer answered 「同意,立卡」. The North Star half is the companion card filed with this one (titled "docs(north-star): priority rule 4 gains the human-facing standard"); this card is the checklist half.

Reader: the dev the skills lane dispatches. Two surfaces: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/SWEEP.md` (not governed) and `.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md` (Tier S, `.claude/**`). A mixed diff is not judged by proportion, so the Tier S hunk goes in its own PR and lands on the contract-review PASS; the SWEEP.md PR lands on the normal path.

## What the angle is

The sweep's angle table enumerates the platform from independent readers and diffs each against the checklist. Every existing angle hunts for a capability with no item. This angle hunts for a different miss class: a surface that renders, passes its functional items, and still violates the one design system — hand-rolled wrappers around primitives, per-usage spacing and width, a selection column with no affordance, two status bars where one belongs, a primary action enabled with nothing to act on. The first specimen is objectui's shared `RecordPickerDialog` (ten call sites), whose every visible defect maps to one such override.

Add one row to the table in `SWEEP.md` 「What a sweep is」, in the table's own grammar (angle · enumerate from · catches):

- angle: **Surface kinds vs the one design system**
- enumerate from: objectui `apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx`; the `@object-ui/components` primitives a surface composes (Dialog, Table, Input, Checkbox, Button, the custom wrappers under `packages/components/src/custom/`); every widget that composes them into a surface kind — dialog, record picker, list, form, record page, dashboard, empty state, loading state
- catches: surfaces that pass their functional items but override the design system — a wrapper carrying a second border, a container killing the primitive's header rhythm, a fixed width unrelated to content, selection without the Checkbox primitive, split status bars, a confirm enabled at zero selected, navigational links inside a picker (the `RecordPickerDialog` class, 2026-10)

The items this angle authors are **one per surface kind, not one per screen** — the list of kinds above is the whole finite set, so the angle cannot sprawl into taste cards. Each item's oracle is `screenshot` for "renders as the primitive composes it" and `dom` after that for the checkable facts (the Checkbox primitive is present in multi-select rows; exactly one border on the search input; the confirm control carries `disabled` at zero selected; one footer bar). The reference is the design system's own composition (objectui `AGENTS.md` rule #3, "serializable Shadcn": follow Shadcn's DOM structure), ⛔ never a reference image checked into the repo — `runs/README.md` keeps screenshots out of git, and this angle keeps that.

Prose that counts the angles follows the table: 「Five READ-ONLY gap-hunter agents」 and step 2 「Dispatch the five hunters」 in `SWEEP.md`; `five-angle` in the skill's description line, 「5 个 hunter」 and 「五个角度」 in `.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md`. North Star priority rule 4: a doc or skill written for AI that says the wrong count is a product defect, so the count words change with the row. Row position is not content: the maintainer has a planned sweep instruction for a "four promises" angle (#22172, 「加第六角:四个承诺」); whichever lands first takes the next number.

## ⛔ Not this card

- Running the sweep: the maintainer triggers it (「跑一轮 coverage sweep」) after PR #22179 lands; the sweep authors the items and reconciles `coverage.json`.
- Fixing any surface: objectui's `RecordPickerDialog` contract card (filed together with this one) is the first repair; later repairs are cards the sweep's `FOLLOW-UPS.md` surfaces.
- Any weighting in `coverage.json` between core and projection: withdrawn by the maintainer at #22172.

## Landing shape

- PR 1: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/SWEEP.md` — the row and the two count words; `Fixes` this card; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` stays green.
- PR 2: `.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md` — the three count words only; references this card; Tier S: draft until the contract review PASS, then ready → queue; the skill lints (`check-skill-line-ratchet`, `check-skill-id-lint`) green.
- Acceptance: the table has the row above in the table's grammar; every count word in both files agrees with the table; nothing else in either file moves.

Dedupe: the 128 open objectstack issues were listed through the repository endpoint and scanned (title and body) for coverage sweep / sweep angle / 第六角 / 第七角 / 设计师经手 / 美观 / design system: 0. Prior rulings read: recordpickerdialog, design system, 设计系统, 美观, visual baseline, shadcn → 0 hits.
